reviews.author: master
reviews.text: The service is hectic and the level of customization is quite poor. I requested a complete customization using expensive imported fabric, and after seeing the basting, I thought it was strange that they tried to go straight into the finished product without any intermediate basting, but I requested that they look at the basting again.  When it comes to customization, basting is important. During the consultation, I asked how many times I saw the basting. I saw it about 3 times and was told it would take 3 to 4 weeks. I asked if there was a set date for it to be worn, so I said there was no and asked for it to be done well, and it took over 2 months to be completed. When I asked my wife if it took too long, the person in charge of the Jongno branch was very displeased and said that it wasn't late because you had set a date to wear it quickly. The answer was completely devoid of service spirit.... I didn't complain much, but I was very offended by this response, so I wanted to refund it, but I just moved on. What's more problematic is that custom suits are less complete than ready-made suits. The pants size clearly requested during Gabon was different, the waist did not fit, and the front button of the top was off by more than 1 cm, so when I fastened it, the clothes came out crooked. I was so annoyed that I didn't pay much attention when trying it on, but the master tailor who was checking the condition of the clothes right next to me pretended not to notice even though he clearly checked the condition, so I went home, tried it on again, checked the condition, and made changes again. The price is high, the service is poor, and the quality is poor. There are many reputable tailor shops with the same price. I hope you make a good choice.

reviews.author: Pretty girl genius
reviews.text:
It's a hip grocery market concept in a traditional market.

It's located not far from the center of Gwangjang Market's food alley, making it easy to come and go. There are a variety of light snacks and snacks, including traditional Korean alcohol, various wines and beers that are easy to drink, non-alcoholic drinks, and glass wine. It's a good place to buy alcohol and snacks and eat some food together at Gwangjang Market. It's full of not only food, but also cute small items and cute little things that are great as gifts. There were a lot of small items with traditional motifs, so I looked around without realizing how time passed. There are some goods I've seen at the National Museum of Korea, and the prices are the same, so I bought a few here. There are also things like cell phone cases and grip toks with the concept of Gwangjang Market, which are great as souvenirs. I think it will be a fun and good place for foreign tourists.

We had a pleasant evening at a nearby hostel with alcohol and snacks purchased here.

He kicked the customers out and didn’t let them buy anything… etc. There were countless other horrible actions and attitudes. Eight of us shopped at different times and on different days of the week, and we all experienced the employee's attitude. This is the worst person I have ever met in my many visits to Korea! When we finally started arguing, he kept saying he didn't understand, why we were so upset, why we were treating him like that. However, we believe that the language barrier has nothing to do with his behavior or attitude. His actions showed serious disregard for his customers. Plus he was really pretentious.
